blurb: Beyond Dance offers personalized wedding dance choreography and group lessons for couples and bridal parties. They provide a wide range of dance classes for all ages and skill levels, including ballet, jazz, hip hop, tap, modern, contemporary, and acro. The studio emphasizes a nurturing environment and community connection through dance.
